test_title: PYST 50: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The profit earned on selling an article for Rs. 3300 is 10 times of the loss incurred on selling the same article for Rs. 2970. What will be the selling price of the article to earn a profit of 30 percent?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price at profit = Rs. 3300

Selling price at loss = Rs. 2970

Profit = 10 × Loss

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) - Profit

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price (SP) + Loss

Required Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 + Profit Percentage)

**Calculation:**

Let the loss be L.

Profit = 10L

⇒ 3300 = CP + 10L

⇒ 2970 = CP - L

⇒ 3300 - CP = 10L

⇒ CP - 2970 = L

Adding these equations:

3300 - CP + CP - 2970 = 10L + L

⇒ 3300 - 2970 = 11L

⇒ 330 = 11L

⇒ L = 330 / 11

⇒ L = 30

Now, CP = 2970 + 30

⇒ CP = 3000

To earn a profit of 30%:

Required SP = 3000 × (1 + 30/100)

⇒ Required SP = 3000 × 1.3

⇒ Required SP = 3900

**The selling price of the article to earn a profit of 30 percent is Rs. 3900.**
